events.text: User confirmed the matcap live on their own HEAD_ONE model after restarting onto the new build: the side view that was one flat mass now reads every facet. Verbatim: 'yeah thats much better'.

resolution: The question could not be answered from the render — which was the point. Counted honestly: maybe 20-30 edges discernible in the faceted crown + a few crease notches on the right silhouette, zero across the entire interior; the true count is unknowable from flat N-dot-L shading because an edge only reads when its faces land in different brightness bands (low-dihedral edges and light-symmetric creases collapse into one tone; no light direction fixes it). Built the fix the work order named: matcap shading on the model stage — new Scene3D matcap prop plumbed layout→uniform→scene3d_fs, shading by view-space normal with a sphere ramp + warm/cool hue split + grazing darkening, enabled whenever not in Paint/Flat. Cube faces went from near-identical bands (180/156/148) to distinct tone AND hue (bright top 135/127/99, cool left 81/88/96, warm right 113/88/59) — edges read with no overlay. Honest limit documented in SKILL.md + memory: smooth-shaded normals still blend across interiors, so organic blobs like the demonstration rock need a faceted-normals stage mode or cavity/AO as the remaining P1-0 follow-up. part-sync-parity and mesh-audit gates green.
